newsitem.title: USA: N. Dakota lawmakers expected to wrap up budget Fri.
newsitem.headline: N. Dakota lawmakers expected to wrap up budget Fri.

text.p: North Dakota legislators expect to finish work Friday on a $1.94 billion biennial budget for the period beginning July 1.
Lawmakers had sought to complete work on the 1997-99 budget late Thursday.
Gov. Ed Schafer's proposed budget includes an increase of $75 million for education and $5 million for water development.
In introducing the proposed budget last December, Schafer said lawmakers had an additional $147 million in new revenues to work with due to economic growth.
